title: Inheritance and its types in Java
answer: Inheritance lets a subclass acquire accessible state and behavior from a superclass and specialize or extend it. Java class inheritance supports single inheritance; structures can also be multilevel or hierarchical. Java does not support multiple superclass inheritance, but classes can implement multiple interfaces, enabling hybrid-style designs. AeroTopo shows hierarchical inheritance with `Orthomosaic` and `Dem` extending `Product`, and multiple interface contracts through `Exportable` and `Identified`.
